data.title: Move current site into random/ and turn index.html into a breakpoint router (random at 800-900px)

data.body: Implemented per plan: git mv'd script.js/style.css into random/ (100% renames, contents untouched), created random/index.html as the standalone sub-site page (relative asset paths, noindex, five sections preserved), rewrote root index.html as the iframe breakpoint router (head meta block byte-identical to original incl. trailing spaces; static src=./random/ for no-JS; BUCKET_SITES map with 800:'random', DEFAULT_SITE fallback, mobile portrait/landscape constants, debounced resize with swap-only-on-change), and appended the Site Architecture section to CLAUDE.md. Verified: router JS passes node --check, local http.server shows 200s for /, /random/, both cache-busted assets, and all root assets (CNAME, favicon.ico, splash.png, twitter-splash-malls.png) untouched; root page has 10 og: matches. No deviations from the plan. Commit 29427ed on liquid.

REVIEW (commit 29427edc, cold read vs plan): PASS. Verified: (1) random/ fully self-contained — script.js/style.css moved via git mv, byte-identical to 896e696 versions (diff clean); random/index.html body markup identical to old root (5 sections, order preserved), relative ./style.css?vbvcxb and ./script.js?fdasfadsfbvcxbdsa resolve under /random/ (curl 200s via local http.server). script.js section[0..3] indexing intact; mailto target is section[3] (4th section), matching CSS section:nth-child(4) cursor. (2) Root router matches plan verbatim: BUCKET_SITES {800:'random'}, DEFAULT_SITE fallback, mobile portrait/landscape constants, hover/pointer mobile detection, 100ms debounced resize, only-swap-on-change guard, orientation change listener, static iframe src=./random/ for no-JS. Bucket math correct (floor(w/100)*100; 800<=w<900 -> 800 key; everything else -> DEFAULT_SITE). (3) Root head meta verbatim through line 30 (title/description/all og:*/all twitter:*/canonical — 10 og: tags served); only the font/style/script includes dropped, per plan. CNAME/favicon.ico/splash.png/twitter-splash-malls.png untouched, all 200. (4) Iframe hygiene: border:0, display:block, position:fixed inset 0, root overflow:hidden — fills viewport, no double scrollbars. (5) Commit touched exactly the 5 planned paths; .lattice/, agents.md, liquid/, memphis/ not staged; working tree clean vs HEAD. CLAUDE.md ends with Site Architecture section, Lattice section untouched. Nothing fixed inline. One non-blocking observation for future mobile sub-site work: style.css's calc(100vh - 110px) mobile hack was tuned for standalone Safari URL-bar geometry; inside the iframe, 100vh equals the iframe box, so the 110px offset may leave a gap on small screens — worth revisiting when the mobile variants are built (not a regression introduced by this task's structure per plan's accepted tradeoffs, and mobile currently routes to random either way).
